**Multiplayer with room codes.** New Node WebSocket server (`app/server/index.js`) + client netcode (`net.js`): create a room from the MULTIPLAYER menu, share the 4-letter code (unambiguous alphabet, no 0/O/1/I), up to 8 players in free-for-all deathmatch to 15 kills. Server is authoritative for damage, kills, scores, and respawns; positions sync at 15 Hz with interpolated remote players, TAB scoreboard, respawn overlay, room banner. The playtest spins up two actual browser clients: ALICE creates room, BOB joins by code, they see and render each other, ALICE shoots BOB (server applies damage), kill credits the scoreboard, BOB respawns at 100 hp.

**Map diversity.** Three maps with genuinely different layouts and moods, selectable on the menu: VECTOR (original neon night arena), FOUNDRY (ember-orange furnace hall with raised central platform and ring corridor), CANOPY (violet-dusk rooftops with bridges and a lower street level).
